strings.name: Uğur Şahin
strings.summary: Şahin moved from Turkey to Germany as a child, studied medicine in Cologne and researched immune recognition of cancer. With Türeci, Huber and others he co-founded BioNTech, linking tumor immunology to development and helping teams create a COVID-19 mRNA vaccine with Pfizer. In 2026 a new-venture and succession plan was announced; plans remain distinct from completed transitions.
